parse_video3d_params: parse command line arguments for video 3D depth estimation using Video3dParamsParser
initialize_video3d_parser: initialize the Video3dParamsParser with all video, flow, calibration, and fine-tuning arguments
configure_kitti_params: configure Video3dParamsParser for KITTI dataset with FlowNet2-KITTI and monodepth2 model
add_flow_args: add optical flow arguments including flow_ops, flow_checkpoint, and overlap_ratio to the parser
add_fine_tuning_args: add depth fine-tuning arguments including model_type and frame_range to the parser
